quote.text: Stop preventing philosophers from possessing money; no one has condemned wisdom to poverty. I will despise whatever lies in the domain of Fortune, but if a choice is offered, I will choose the better half.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Instill in your children the idea that true wealth lies in wisdom and character—not in material gain; nurture a mind that values learning over mere accumulation.
    • Lead by example: show that ethical choices and inner riches set a foundation for a fulfilling life, even when external fortunes seem unpredictable.
  • Leadership:
    • Embrace the concept that while financial resources can support endeavors, the strength of wisdom and virtue makes for enduring leadership.
    • Choose to cultivate a resilient mindset, prioritizing informed judgment and moral clarity over temporary successes offered by fortune.
  • Product Management:
    • Focus on the intrinsic value of ideas and the long-term benefits of well-crafted products, rather than chasing fleeting trends or short-term gains.
    • Recognize that true product success emerges from a blend of creative insight and strategic vision—where wisdom directs decisions more reliably than the ephemeral tides of fortune.
